findings.note: Migration inventory cites Quality/Tasks.ts:1777 and quality-tasks.test.ts:1227,1261 as the unchanged goals index --check sites, but those lines are unrelated (streaming-lane JSDoc and lane-proof tests). Live --check argv is Tasks.ts:2326 and quality-tasks.test.ts:2048,2084. goals-bootstrap-plan.test.ts:419-437 also exercises --check/--write through the CLI and is unnamed.

Executor.ts:468-469 reads v.errors and v.warnings on every per-node ValidationResult, and GraphOperations.test.ts:276,299 assert validation.valid/result.valid. After the tagged union only invalid carries errors and valid is not a field. The design's claim that no .valid reader exists is false, and those payload and test readers are not named for case-matching, so an implementer could reintroduce a valid boolean getter.

XAi.service.ts:801-802 writes error events as {data: websocketErrorData(error), kind:"error", reason}. The design lists data among shared optional message fields to strip from close/error and never names the live close (code, reason) or error (data, reason) members, so applying that deletion list would drop the error payload.
